name: SM_Chest_Small_Lid110_PR

textures.channels: the Props chest's colour map with the inside of body and lid darkened

supersedes: SM_Chest_Small_Open_PR (lid at 102 degrees) on this frame
dresses: the iron-bound chest of the Props kit with its lid at 110 degrees: the same vertices, normal and ORM maps (Props T_Chest_Small_PR_*), the lid turned about its back hinges; its own colour map only to make the inside dark
source_note: FableF/tools/build_chest_states.py from Props/Chest_Small/SM_Chest_Small_PR.fbx and Props/Chest_Small_Open/SM_Chest_Small_Open_PR.fbx (the lid = the vertices that differ between the two); no new bake

fit.pivot: base centre, identical to SM_Chest_Small_PR: swap the mesh in place
fit.hinge: axis along X through (y 0.257, z 0.36) m
